cache.description:
Snakemake: reuse the results of the workflow's `cache: True` rules across runs, from a
per-project S3 cache (`cache: true` in `biffix.yaml`).

catalog.description:
How the version is listed in the Lab's pipeline catalog (`catalog:` in `biffix.yaml`),
normalized at registration (see [`normalize_catalog`]).

curated.description: True when the author curated this form (`biffix.yaml` has a `form:` block).

fields.description: Fields in display order: grouped by section, in the source schema's order within one.

references.description: A reference-bundle dropdown that fills several params, when the author declared one.

reports.description:
Reports the workflow's runs write, shown on a run's Reports tab (`reports:` in
`biffix.yaml`). Frozen with the form so every run of the version resolves the same
declarations.

run_name.description: A run-name template; `{date}` and `{workflow}` are filled by the UI.

samples.description:
How to match the workflow's tasks to samples (`samples:` in `biffix.yaml`), frozen with the
form so every run of the version attributes its tasks the same way.

sections.description: Sections in display order. Empty for a form frozen before sections existed.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues encountered while adapting (lenient skip-and-warn).

ColumnRole.description: What a samplesheet column holds, so detected samples fill it.

Contact.description:
A person (or team) to ask for help: a workflow's `catalog.contact`, or the site's support
contact.

url.description:
A help page (a ticket form, a chat channel): an `http(s)` URL of at most
[`MAX_CONTACT_URL_CHARS`] characters.

FormCatalog.description: How a version is listed in the Lab's pipeline catalog (`catalog:` in `biffix.yaml`).

contact.description:
Who Lab users ask when one of the workflow's runs needs attention; wins over the site's
support contact for its runs. Checked by [`normalize_contact`].

description.description:
A plain-language description for the pipeline's card, trimmed and at most
[`MAX_CATALOG_DESCRIPTION_CHARS`] characters.

tags.description:
Tags the catalog filters on: trimmed, non-empty, unique ignoring case (the first spelling
kept), at most [`MAX_CATALOG_TAGS`] of at most [`MAX_CATALOG_TAG_CHARS`] characters.

verified.description: The author vouches for the workflow (a *Verified* badge). Author-declared, not reviewed.

FormExample.description: A named, known-good set of inputs the author offers (*Start from example*).

params.description: Param values keyed by field name.

accepts_folder.description:
A path input that may name a file **or** a folder (nf-schema `format: path`): the server
checks it exists as an object, else as a prefix. Rendered as an `s3_file` field.

default.description:
The value the engine uses when the param is not given (the engine schema's `default`). It is
what `show_if` gating assumes for an omitted param on every surface (server, CLI, UI), so it
is never the author's form prefill: that is [`FormField::prefill`].

exclusive_max.description: Exclusive upper bound (JSON Schema `exclusiveMaximum`): a value must be less.

exclusive_min.description: Exclusive lower bound (JSON Schema `exclusiveMinimum`): a value must be greater.

help.description: A help paragraph (nf-schema `help_text`, or the author's), longer than `description`.

is_output.description: Marks an output path — the validator skips existence-checking it.

is_path_input.description: True for path-typed inputs that should be HEAD-checked.

json_type.description:
The param's JSON Schema `type` (`boolean`, `integer`, `string`…), when the schema declares
one; absent on forms frozen before it was recorded.

label.description: The author's label; absent ⇒ the UI humanizes `name`.

multiple.description: The param takes a list of paths (`multiple: true` in biffix.yaml)

multiple_of.description: A value must be a whole multiple of this (JSON Schema `multipleOf`).

prefill.description:
The value a fresh launch form starts with (the `form.params.<name>.default` overlay). The UI
fills it in as an entered value, so it is submitted explicitly; a CLI/API submit that omits
the param gets [`FormField::default`], exactly as the engine would.

samplesheet.description:
A samplesheet field's columns (from nf-core's row schema or the author's `form:` block), so
the form can build the sheet from files and the server can write it.

section.description: The id of the [`FormSection`] the field belongs to.

show_if.description: All must hold for the field to be active; an inactive field is dropped before validation.

step.description:
The number input's increment, a UI hint only: `1` for an integer param unless the overlay
sets another. Whole numbers are enforced by `json_type` (`integer`), not by this; a form
frozen before `json_type` was recorded falls back to `step: 1` as the integer marker.

suffixes.description:
File-name endings a path input accepts (`.fastq.gz`), from the `suffix` hint; the file
picker filters by them.

unit.description: A unit shown with the label (`bp`, `reads`).

FormReferences.description:
A reference-bundle dropdown: picking a bundle fills each `fill` param from
the bundle's key of the same mapping; only bundles with every `required` key are offered.

custom.description: Offer *Use my own files…*: the filled params' own fields instead of a bundle.

help.description: A help paragraph for the dropdown's ⓘ (which reference suits which samples).

kind.description: Offer only bundles of this kind.

required.description: Bundle keys a bundle must have to be offered.

FormReport.description: A report the workflow's runs write.

kind.description:
How the report is shown, as the author declared it (one of [`REPORT_KINDS`]); `None` ⇒ from
the file's name ([`report_format`]).

path.description:
A path or glob relative to the run's output prefix (see [`crate::glob`]). A `per_sample`
report's path holds `{sample}`.

per_sample.description: One report per sample: `{sample}` in `path` is each of the run's sample ids in turn.

FormSection.description:
A titled group of fields. Non-advanced sections are cards; advanced ones collapse together under
one *Advanced* disclosure.

Lanes.description: What to do with one sample's files from several lanes.

oneOf.description: One sample with every lane's files (technical replicates).
A problem to fix: the workflow takes one file per read.

Preset.description: A named value for a field, shown as a chip (`Duplex (3)` → `3`).

Rule.description: A pattern a string value must match, with the message shown when it does not.

SampleHint.description:
The author's hint for attributing tasks to samples (`samples:` in `biffix.yaml`), frozen with
the version's form. Every key is optional; without one the default rules apply.

labels.description: Display names for steps, e.g. `STAR_ALIGN: "Align (STAR)"`, named as in `steps`.

steps.description:
Steps forced to one scope, e.g. `joint_call: study`. A step is named by its full group name
or, for a Nextflow process path, its last `:`-separated part (`STAR_ALIGN` names
`NFCORE_RNASEQ:RNASEQ:STAR_ALIGN`); the full name wins when both are given.

additionalProperties.description: Whether a step runs once per sample or once for the whole study (open enum).

tag.description:
Nextflow: a regex over the task's tag whose `sample` group is the sample id. Trusted as
given (its match is the sample even when the sheet does not list it), and it overrides the
default rules, file-name tags included.

wildcard.description:
Snakemake: the wildcard that names the sample. Trusted as given: its value is the sample
even when the run's sheet does not list it.

accepts_folder.description:
A file column whose cells may also name a folder (a row schema's `format: path`): a cell
with no object there is checked again as a prefix.

file.description: A file path (`s3://`), existence-checked at submit.

suffixes.description: File-name endings a file column accepts.

SheetFormat.description: The file format a samplesheet is written in.

SheetSpec.description: A samplesheet as the workflow declares it.

lanes.description: How detection treats several lanes of one sample.

ShowIf.description:
One condition of a field's `show_if`: the field is shown only while `field`'s value is one of
`values` (compared by [`value_key`]).

WidgetHint.description: The semantic widget hint. Keeps the UI decoupled from schema dialects.
